interface: sample_native(task_id, native, seed, parameters=None) -> (pair, metadata); SamplerTimeout.metadata contains failed attempts
scope: Audited compiled985 proposal source reused with unchanged native explicit renderer. Different RNG stream, not Python-native seed equivalence. Native retries reset same seed and restore caller RNG states. No output-label-based retries.
limitations: Timeouts remain finite and can reject valid slow draws; record shortfalls instead of claiming distribution completeness.
Native1b fallback is slow; no compiled1b replacement yet.
Compiled985 requires a local C++17 compiler. Compilation failure falls back explicitly in metadata.
No full-generation throughput measurement or training launch.
generation_provenance: Sampling metadata is serialized in each pool row parameters and carried into final episode pair_parameters. Imported raw samples are explicitly fresh_draws_this_job=false.
